title: Text blocks
subtitle: Snippets you reuse across proposals: payment, deadlines, revisions and anything else.

fields.title: Title
fields.bodyPlaceholder: Write the text you want to reuse...

save.title: Save as block
save.description: Give it a short name to reuse this text in future proposals.

empty.none: You don't have any saved blocks yet.

delete.title: Delete block?
delete.description: This action cannot be undone. Existing proposals are not affected.

payment5050.title: 50/50 payment
payment5050.body: Payment in two installments: 50% upon approval of this proposal and 50% on final delivery.

paymentUpfront.title: Upfront payment
paymentUpfront.body: Full payment upon approval of this proposal. Work starts after payment confirmation.

deadline.title: Delivery deadline
deadline.body: The delivery deadline starts from the approval of this proposal and receipt of all required materials from the client.

revisions.title: Revision rounds
revisions.body: Up to 2 revision rounds are included. Additional changes will be quoted separately.

cancellation.title: Cancellation
cancellation.body: If the project is cancelled after work has started, the amount proportional to the completed stages will be charged.

validity.title: Proposal validity
validity.body: This proposal is valid for 15 days from the date it was sent.

whatIncludes.title: What's included
whatIncludes.body: The items listed above are included. Services not described in this proposal are out of scope.

scope.title: Scope summary
scope.body: This quote covers the deliverables described below, with support throughout the project.

help.title: What are text blocks for?
help.what: Ready-made texts you reuse in proposals: terms, payment conditions, warranty, "why me" and notes.
help.step1: Create a block here with a title and text.
help.step2: In the proposal, click "Insert block" next to the field.
help.step3: The text goes into the field and you can still edit it.
help.picker: Pick a ready-made text from your library for this field. Create new ones in Text blocks.
